set.body: Implement exact-grid composition with explicit overlap policy, checked key remapping and both parent provenances. Add typed hemisphere and partial-network grouping with explicit parcel-versus-spatial weighting. Implement assignment-based selection and atlas wrapper for image-layer dilation with explicit metric/radius/tie policy. Acceptance: unequal-size parcel grouping, overlap/ties, incomplete annotations and derived provenance fixtures; JVM and JS. No duplicate numerical or generic mapping algebra.
set.title: Atlas: compose, select, and group through exact parcel assignments
